description: This file declares the CopyPasteManager class responsible for handling copy-paste operations within a calculator application, including validation, extraction, and length constraints, along with related data structures and constants.

classes.name: CopyPasteMaxOperandLengthAndValue
classes.description: A value struct holding maximum length and value for operands during copy-paste operations.

classes.name: CopyPasteManager
classes.description: A sealed class providing static methods and properties for managing copy-paste functionality in the calculator app.

methods.name: CopyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies a string to the system clipboard.

methods.name: GetStringToPaste
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a string from the clipboard suitable for pasting, based on current calculator mode and settings.

methods.name: HasStringToPaste
methods.description: Checks if there is a string available in the clipboard to paste.

methods.name: IsErrorMessage
methods.description: Determines if a given message string is an error message.

methods.name: ValidatePasteExpression
methods.description: Validates a pasted expression string based on calculator mode, category, number base, and bit length.

methods.name: GetMaxOperandLengthAndValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum operand length and value for a given calculator mode, category, number base, and bit length.

methods.name: ExtractOperands
methods.description: Extracts operands from a pasted expression string.

methods.name: ExpressionRegExMatch
methods.description: Checks if the operands match the expected regular expression pattern for the current mode and category.

methods.name: SanitizeOperand
methods.description: Removes unwanted characters from an operand string.

methods.name: RemoveUnwantedCharsFromString
methods.description: Removes unwanted characters from an input string.

methods.name: TryOperandToULL
methods.description: Attempts to convert an operand string to an unsigned long long integer based on the specified number base.

methods.name: StandardScientificOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of an operand in standard or scientific notation.

methods.name: OperandLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of an operand based on mode, category, and number base.

methods.name: ProgrammerOperandLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of a programmer mode operand based on the number base.
